headerDisplay: Exposes a UPS managed by [apcupsd](http://www.apcupsd.org/) to HomeKit. apcupsd must have its Network Information Server enabled (`NETSERVER on` in `/etc/apcupsd/apcupsd.conf`).

host.title: apcupsd host
host.description: Hostname or IP of the machine running apcupsd. Leave empty if it runs on the Homebridge server.

port.title: apcupsd port
port.description: Leave empty to use apcupsd's default NIS port (3551).

contactSensor.title: Expose a mains power sensor
contactSensor.description: Triggered when the UPS is running on battery, idle while mains power is connected. Turn off if you only want the battery status.

powerSensorType.title: Mains power sensor type

oneOf.title: Leak sensor (critical alert on power cut)
Smoke sensor (critical alert on power cut)

powerSensorType.description: HomeKit sends leak and smoke alerts as critical notifications that show up even in Do Not Disturb or Focus. Note that the Home app will also label the power cut as a leak or smoke alarm.

temperatureSensor.title: Expose a temperature sensor
temperatureSensor.description: Publishes the UPS internal temperature (apcupsd's ITEMP value). Only Smart-UPS models report it; Back-UPS and most consumer models don't, and would show 0 °C.

loadSensor.title: Expose a load sensor
loadSensor.description: Publishes the UPS load (apcupsd's LOADPCT value, % of its rated power in use). HomeKit has no load sensor type, so it shows up as a humidity sensor named "<Name> Load".

voltageSensor.title: Expose a line voltage sensor
voltageSensor.description: Publishes the input line voltage (apcupsd's LINEV value). HomeKit has no voltage sensor type, so it shows up as a light sensor named "<Name> Voltage": 222 lux means 222 V.

lowBatteryLevel.title: Low battery below (%)
lowBatteryLevel.description: Report low battery when the charge is at or below this percentage.

lowBatteryMinutes.title: Low battery below (minutes of runtime)
lowBatteryMinutes.description: While running on battery, report low battery when the estimated runtime left is at or below this many minutes.

interval.title: Polling interval (seconds)
interval.description: How often the UPS status is read. Lower values detect power cuts sooner.

errorLogsOnly.title: Only log errors
errorLogsOnly.description: Hide the informational log lines (power, battery and charging state changes).

model.title: Model
model.description: Only used if the UPS doesn't report it.

serial.title: Serial number
serial.description: Only used if the UPS doesn't report it.

firmwareRevision.title: Firmware revision
firmwareRevision.description: Only used if the UPS doesn't report it.

layout.title: Low battery alert
layout.description: The UPS's own low battery warning is always used. Optionally, also report low battery earlier:

layout.title: Accessory information
layout.description: Normally filled in automatically from what the UPS reports.
